pairs.subject: model-routing
pairs.evidence: desk/src/lib/english/check.ts:91 Linga selects a tier at its call sites without a required closed call class or centralized class-to-tier-and-effort mapping, so its routing does not meet the standard.

techniques.evidence: desk/src/lib/engines/registry.ts:48 Linga's engine retrieves one configured provider by name; it does not order eligible candidates using live measurements.
desk/src/lib/engines/text.ts:114 The routing layer reads provider override state from the environment instead of receiving an attributable override from Linga's call edge.

desk/src/lib/engines/codex.ts:47 When Codex serves Linga, this adapter ignores its measured thinking:false setting and independently selects effort from another parameter, environment state, or medium.

desk/src/lib/english/check.ts:210 Duplicate choices can pass the engine schema and be booked as successful before this generic Error rejects them; the unusable completion does not enter the typed routing-failure taxonomy.
desk/src/lib/engines/shape.ts:152 The engine's automatic repair calls the same provider p; no incident-triggered alternate-provider transition exists on this path to exercise.
desk/src/lib/engines/text.ts:61 The reported identity combines the adapter and configured model alias, without a separate stable logical-model identity and endpoint-member identity.

desk/src/lib/engines/meter.ts:36 Linga's engine ledger records usage and provider but omits selected effort, policy version, deciding rule, and override attribution, preventing reconstruction of the routing decision.

desk/src/lib/english/conversation.ts:568 These observations assess the learner's submitted reply for learning evidence; this path does not feed operational or semantic provider scores into candidate ranking.

desk/src/lib/engines/text.ts:122 Linga's text boundary invokes the configured provider directly; the registry supplies neither validated permission rules nor a decision containing the selecting rule chain.
desk/src/lib/english/check.ts:91 The caller chooses fast directly and supplies a feature usage label; no required semantic class selects a tier-and-effort pair through one authoritative mapping.
